info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Meetings Meetings Recordings-v3-spec
info.description: The Meeting Recordings Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about recorded meetings stored within the system. This endpoint provides functionality for retrieving recordings associated with specific meetings, enabling seamless access to past sessions for review or auditing purposes. Typical consumers include team members, facilitators, or administrators who require insights into recorded content for training, compliance, or documentation needs. The API simplifies the retrieval of important meeting resources, enhancing collaboration and continuity within organizations.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the recording of a specific meeting. It returns relevant details about the recording, including availability and format.

requestBody.description: The request body for fetching meeting recordings. Ensure that the JSON structure matches the specified schema.

ListMeetingsMeetingsRecordingsRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON request body for retrieving meeting recordings. It is expected to be a string.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the recording operation.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the recording operation.

state.description: The current state of the recording operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the result.

audit.description: Information about the audit details of the recording operation.

ListMeetingsMeetingsRecordingsResponse_2.description: Response schema representing the outcome of a recording operation for meetings.

createdBy.description: The user who created the recording entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the recording entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the recording was created automatically.

Audit.description: Audit details associated with the recording operation.

schema.description: The amount of time in milliseconds that the server spent processing the request.
